title: Project Memory record version (P tier)
description: Stable, validated repository knowledge: commands, constraints, conventions, architecture and confirmed decisions (Glossary). One file = one version; versions of the same fact share memory_id.

category.description: Semantic, normative and procedural memory (2.3.1). Episodic material (attempts, failures) belongs in the Daily Log and Session Memory, not here.

claim.description: One fact unit, stated so it can be checked against evidence.

status.description: Status as of this version. uncertain = drift suspected, awaiting revalidation (Appendix D). Version files are write-once (D1), so 'superseded' is not stored: a version is superseded when a later version of the same memory_id exists. Archived and superseded versions stay readable (no permanent deletion, 3.11).

support.description: Why the claim is allowed into Project Memory. Unverified inferences stay out (2.4.2); they live in Session Memory as tentative findings.

evidence.description: At least one evidence reference; unsupported durable claims are blocked (FR5).

paths.description: Repository paths the claim depends on; used by drift checks (missing or changed paths, 2.11).

content_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical claim text (see docs/requirements_v1.md §4).

source_commit.description: Repository version the claim was established against.

$comment: Support rules (docs/requirements_v1.md §6, decision D3). The Policy Gate may be stricter, never looser.
